scriptData.label: @effect.name

description.label: Description
description.value:
The end of one of the forearm bones is severed near the elbow, leaving the arm muscles no leverage to work with as the tendons try in vain to work with a suddenly mobile attachment point.

Effects: Gain @Condition[Stunned] (2) and @Condition[Bleeding] (2). Also, you suffer a @UUID[Compendium.wfrp4e-core.items.Item.rlDZZTj5PXjuRXa2]{Broken Bone (Major)}.
